item_name: Rothco NIJ Approved Stainless Steel Handcuffs
item_short_desc: Rothco’s NIJ Approved Stainless Steel Handcuffs offer superior security and durability, meeting NIJ Standard 0307.01. Made from high-quality stainless steel, these duty handcuffs feature a double-locking mechanism, providing enhanced control and preventing accidental tightening. The handcuffs come with 2 keys, ensuring you always have a backup on hand. Designed for law enforcement and security personnel, the cuffs provide a secure and reliable restraint solution while maintaining comfort and ease of use.
